_about: Working non-specialist question set for Ask (audience 2: sysadmins, developers, help desk, managers, compliance and vendor-review staff who need an answer fast). Graded in code by scripts/eval-ask.mjs, never by a model. Questions are written for this repo. A named CVE must go through cve_lookup and the answer must call its rating "the hub's priority" (the prompt's rule). No phrase ban for "vendor's priority": a correct answer may say "not the vendor's". When a hub tool does the job ([[patch-list]], [[kev-product]], [[headers]], [[ioc]], [[lookup]], [[ports]], [[cert]]), the answer must link it. Same fields as beginner.json (see its _about). tests/eval-grade.test.mjs checks this file's shape.

questions.question: Is CVE-2021-44228 urgent for us? We run a few internal Java apps.
Our scanner flagged CVE-2023-4966 on our Citrix NetScaler. How fast do we need to patch it?
Should I worry about CVE-2024-3400? We use Palo Alto firewalls with GlobalProtect.
I have a list of 10 CVE IDs from a vulnerability scan. Which should I patch first?
Which Fortinet vulnerabilities are known to be exploited? We have FortiGates at three sites.
What's the difference between a CVSS 9.8 and a high EPSS score, and which matters more when I decide what to patch?

questions.topic: where did this email come from
questions.question: A user forwarded a suspicious email to the help desk. How do I check where it really came from?
I have a firewall log full of IPs and domains. How can I pull the indicators out and check whether any are known bad?
Our IT provider left port 3389 open to the internet on one server. Is that a problem?
Staff get a certificate warning on one of our internal sites. How do I see who issued the certificate and when it expires?
A vendor security questionnaire asks whether we enforce MFA and encrypt data at rest. What do those mean in plain words?
Our compliance team asked me what a SOC 2 Type II report shows compared with Type I. Explain it simply.
